sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A LOW AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE FROM THE MO VALLEY ENEWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY REGION DURING THE DAY...HELPING TO MOVE MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY NEWD WITH A THREAT OF SEVERE HAIL AND WIND. MEANWHILE...A MORE SUBSTANTIAL UPPER TROUGH WILL MOVE INTO THE NRN PLAINS WITH LOW PRESSURE DEEPENING ACROSS THE DAKOTAS INTO WRN MN SWWD ACROSS NEB. BOTH SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS

sections.title: MID MO INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: SCATTERED WARM ADVECTION STORMS MAY EXIST ACROSS MN AND IA EARLY NEAR A WARM FRONT...WITH A MARGINAL HAIL THREAT. THEN...STRONG SLY FLOW WILL BRING MID 60S F BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS NWD INTO THE REGION...CREATING STRONG INSTABILITY OVER THE WARM SECTOR. CONVERGENCE WILL INCREASE ALONG THE COLD FRONT/SURFACE TROUGH. GIVEN LITTLE IF ANY CONVECTIVE INHIBITION...STORMS SHOULD ERUPT BY 21Z...BEGINNING OVER NRN MN NEAR THE SURFACE LOW...THEN FARTHER SWWD ALONG THE SFC TROUGH. WIND PROFILES WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS...WITH VERY LARGE HAIL LIKELY. LOW LEVEL SHEAR MAY BE ENHANCED OVER CNTRL/NRN MN DUE TO THE EFFECTS OF EARLY CONVECTION AND WHERE A WARM FRONT WILL HOLD. AS A RESULT...A FEW TORNADOES MAY OCCUR. A STRONG TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT IF LOW LEVEL SHEAR ENDS UP BEING AS STRONG AS SOME OF THE NAM FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE. HOWEVER...THERE ARE VARYING MODEL SOLUTIONS...AND WILL MAINTAIN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT AT THIS TIME.

sections.title: LOWER MO INTO THE OH VALLEY
sections.text: NUMEROUS STORMS WILL BE ONGOING OVER MUCH OF MO AND NRN AR TUE MORNING SUPPORTED BY AN UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND WARM ADVECTION WITH A SWLY LOW LEVEL JET. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY SHIFT NEWD WITH THE UPPER WAVE...WITH AN ISOLATED WIND AND HAIL THREAT OVER A LARGE AREA. STORMS WILL LIKELY REGENERATE ON OLD OUTFLOW AND THE LOCATION OF THE STRONGEST STORMS WILL DEPEND ON WHERE POCKETS OF INSTABILITY CAN DEVELOP...MOST LIKELY ON SWRN FLANKS OF EARLY STORMS. WITH HEATING EXPECTED OVER TN AND SRN KY...THE ZONE OF SEVERE MAY EXTEND ROUGHLY FROM ST. LOUIS TO LOUISVILLE. UNCERTAINTY REGARDING LOCATION OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL MARGINAL DEEP SHEAR WILL PRECLUDE A SLIGHT AT THIS TIME. ..JEWELL/GARNER.. 05/01/2012

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST AND WESTERN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A LARGE LOW AMPLITUDE TROUGH IS DEEPENING ACROSS THE NORTHWEST STATES THIS MORNING...WITH WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SUGGESTING THE MAIN SHORTWAVE TROUGH AXIS OVER ID. AS THIS FEATURE DIGS SOUTHEASTWARD LATER TODAY...LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL SPREAD INTO THE NORTHERN/CENTRAL PLAINS. A DEEPENING SURFACE LOW OVER THE EASTERN DAKOTAS/WESTERN MN WILL BE THE FOCUS FOR INITIAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY MID AFTERNOON...WITH STORMS BUILDING SOUTHWARD INTO PARTS OF NEB/IA. STRONG INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP THROUGH THE DAY AS STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND FULL SUNSHINE COMBINE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S. FAVORABLE EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL STORM STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THAT STORMS WILL GROW UPSCALE THROUGH THE EVENING AS THEY SPREAD EASTWARD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY...WITH A CONTINUED THREAT OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS UNTIL AT LEAST MIDNIGHT.

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED MCV IS CURRENTLY OVER MO WITH AN ARCING LINE OF CONVECTION EXTENDING SOUTHWARD INTO NORTHERN AR. MORNING SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS THE SOUTHEAST STATES WITH SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS HELPING TO TRANSPORT THAT AIR MASS NORTHWARD INTO THE OH VALLEY. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORMS WILL INTENSIFY BY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF SOUTHERN IL/WESTERN KY AND SPREAD EASTWARD ROUGHLY ALONG THE OH RIVER THROUGH THE EVENING. SUFFICIENTLY STRONG WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL PROMOTE A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL IN THE STRONGER STORMS. A WEAK SURFACE BOUNDARY CURRENTLY ACROSS KY/TN WILL LIFT NORTHWARD AND MAY PROVIDE SUFFICIENT LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE/SHEAR FOR SOME RISK OF SUPERCELLS AND ISOLATED TORNADOES TODAY. ..HART/SMITH.. 05/01/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF VA/NC
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... LARGE-SCALE PATTERN WILL UNDERGO SLIGHT AMPLIFICATION THIS PERIOD AS A MIDLEVEL JET STREAK AND ASSOCIATED SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE NERN PACIFIC MOVE INLAND ACROSS THE PACIFIC NW INTO NRN ROCKIES. THIS SYSTEM WILL BE PRECEDED BY A SHORTWAVE TROUGH WHICH WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE NRN ROCKIES/NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER GREAT LAKES. FARTHER E...A VORTICITY MAXIMUM --OF CONVECTIVE ORIGIN-- OVER THE OZARKS WILL DEAMPLIFY WHILE PROGRESSING ACROSS THE OH VALLEY. AT THE SURFACE...DUAL LOW PRESSURE CENTERS OVER CNTRL SD AND ERN ND WILL DEVELOP EWD INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY...IN TANDEM WITH A COLD FRONT PROGRESSING ACROSS THE DAKOTAS. A PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH OR DRYLINE WILL SHARPEN TODAY FROM THIS AREA OF LOW PRESSURE SWWD THROUGH CNTRL NEB INTO WRN PARTS OF KS/OK/TX...WITH A WARM FRONT BECOMING BETTER-DEFINED OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER GREAT LAKES. THE ERN EXTENSION OF THE WARM FRONT WILL LIFT SLOWLY NWD THROUGH THE OH VALLEY AND MID ATLANTIC STATES.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY INTO MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: CURRENT MEDICINE BOW WY PROFILER IS SAMPLING THE EXIT REGION OF A 50-60 KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK WHICH WILL DEVELOP NEWD THROUGH THE RED RIVER VALLEY TODAY IN CONCERT WITH A LEAD VORTICITY MAXIMUM. FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THESE FEATURES AND LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE INVOF MIGRATORY SURFACE LOWS ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER SCATTERED TSTMS BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON FROM N-CNTRL MN SWWD ALONG COLD FRONT INTO SERN SD/NERN NEB. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS WIDESPREAD CLOUDS ACROSS MUCH OF MN WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER HEATING AND RESULTANT DESTABILIZATION OVER ERN SD INTO THE MID MO VALLEY. EXPECT THE CLOUDS AND MARGINAL MOISTURE CONTENT TO LIMIT MLCAPE TO 500-1000 J/KG ACROSS NRN MN...WHILE STRONGER HEATING AND A MORE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER YIELDS AFTERNOON MLCAPE TO 1500-2500 J/KG OVER THE MID MO VALLEY. WHEN COMBINED WITH STRENGTHENING LOW AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...ENVIRONMENT WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES. STORMS WILL LIKELY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS OR TWO TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED SEVERE WEATHER RISK ACROSS PARTS OF MN/WI/IA/NEB.

sections.title: MID MS/LOWER MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL WAA ON BACKSIDE OF OH VALLEY MCV WILL INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT IN RESPONSE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A 40-50 KT LLJ FROM KS/OK INTO THE REGION. THIS WILL LIKELY GIVE RISE TO SCATTERED TSTMS ALONG/N OF WARM/STATIONARY FRONT WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. LARGE HAIL WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THESE STORMS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: MESOSCALE AND CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES THAT FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH MCV WILL COMBINE WITH LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG WARM FRONT LIFTING NWD TO FOSTER SCATTERED TSTMS ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON. THE COMBINATION OF DAYTIME HEATING AND A MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER WILL YIELD A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS LATER TODAY WHERE MLCAPE VALUES WILL APPROACH 1000-2000 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY WILL COINCIDE WITH A BELT OF 50 KT SWLY FLOW IN THE 2-6 KM AGL LAYER /PER STL VWP/ ATTENDING MCV...RESULTING IN AN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. A TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE...NAMELY WITH ANY STORMS THAT CAN FAVORABLY INTERACT WITH THE WARM FRONT WHERE THE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR/VORTICITY IS MAXIMIZED.

sections.title: VA/NC THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: SMALL TSTM CLUSTER OVER ERN KY APPEARS TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH AN MCV WHICH WILL TRACK ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS AND INTO THE PIEDMONT LATER TODAY. 12Z RNK SOUNDING SHOWED THE PRESENCE OF A MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIR MASS AND WEAK CAP WITH 40-45 KT WLY FLOW OBSERVED ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER. STRONG DAYTIME HEATING IS EXPECTED TO PROMOTE A STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITH MLCAPE INCREASING TO 1000-1500 J/KG. THOUGH LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE WILL REMAIN WEAK...CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODELS DO INDICATE AN INCREASE IN TSTMS E OF THE BLUE RIDGE THIS AFTERNOON...LIKELY IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE ABOVE-MENTIONED MCV. GIVEN THE MODERATELY STRONG UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND FIELD AND DEGREE OF INSTABILITY...SETUP WILL FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL. FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE...SEE MCD 643.

sections.title: SERN TX TODAY
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED MCV SE OF AUS WILL CONTINUE EWD TODAY...LIKELY SERVING AS THE FOCUS FOR DIURNALLY ENHANCED TSTM DEVELOPMENT. MODIFICATION OF 12Z CRP SOUNDING FOR FORECAST AFTERNOON SURFACE CONDITIONS SUGGESTS AIR MASS WILL BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG. MOREOVER...CURRENT CRP VWP SHOWS THE PRESENCE OF MODESTLY STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WHICH MAY PROMOTE A FEW ROTATING STORMS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR HAIL...LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. ..MEAD/MOSIER.. 05/01/2012

sections.title: 20Z OUTLOOK UPDATE
sections.text: ONLY RELATIVELY MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE 1630Z OUTLOOK...IN AN ATTEMPT TO BETTER ACCOUNT FOR ONGOING TRENDS IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT/DESTABILIZATION. REFER TO LATEST SPC SEVERE WEATHER WATCHES AND MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR THE LATEST DETAILS ON ONGOING OR MORE IMMINENT CONVECTIVE THREATS.

sections.title: N CNTRL PLAINS INTO THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY
sections.text: QUITE A BIT OF UNCERTAINTY LINGERS CONCERNING DETAILS OF STORM INITIATION LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MODERATE TO STRONG DESTABILIZATION APPEARS TO BE OCCURRING ALONG AN AXIS FROM NORTH CENTRAL NEBRASKA INTO SOUTHWEST MINNESOTA...NEAR COINCIDING AXES OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING AND LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...TO THE SOUTH AND SOUTHWEST OF A SURFACE LOW MIGRATING ACROSS NORTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA. LARGE CLOCKWISE CURVED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS APPEAR LIKELY TO REMAIN CONFINED TO THE COOL/STABLE SIDE OF A WARM FRONTAL SHIFTING EASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF EASTERN MINNESOTA/WESTERN WISCONSIN LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. HOWEVER...DEEP LAYER SHEAR BENEATH 30-40 KT SOUTHWESTERLY 500 MB FLOW WILL STILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS AND DEVELOPMENT OF ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS. AND GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO INDICATE A GOOD LIKELIHOOD FOR STORM CONSOLIDATION AND EVOLUTION OF A SUBSTANTIAL MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM NEAR/EAST OF THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY AREA THIS EVENING...IN STRENGTHENING LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION ...AS A SHORT WAVE IMPULSE LIFTS NORTHEAST OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES. ..KERR.. 05/01/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT TUE MAY 01 2012/

sections.title: NEB...IA...SERN SD...MN...WRN WI
sections.text: A LINE OF STORMS HAS CONSOLIDATED ACROSS CNTRL AND SWRN MN...WITH OTHER BOWS AND LONE CELLS FROM SERN SD INTO NWRN IA AND NERN NEB. ALTHOUGH LOW LEVEL MOISTURE IS MARGINAL...DEEP SHEAR WILL KEEP THE STORMS MOVING EWD THROUGH THE EVENING AND OVERNIGHT WITH A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. THE TORNADO THREAT WILL REMAIN CONDITIONAL ON STORM MODE...FAVORING SUPERCELLS. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS 653 AND 654. OTHER STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY DEVELOP SWWD INTO ERN NEB LATER THIS EVENING WITH A HAIL...WIND...AND ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT.

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF STORMS PERSIST FROM IND INTO OH...AND SHOULD FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS HELPED ALONG BY MODESTLY STRONG WLY MEAN WINDS AS THEY TRAVEL EWD ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT. DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR TO BE THE MAIN THREAT GIVEN STORM MODE...WITH A TORNADO THREAT WITH ANY TAIL END CELLS.

sections.title: SWRN TX
sections.text: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER SWRN TX FAVORING THE HIGHER TERRAIN. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 650. ..JEWELL.. 05/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS CAPABLE OF WIND/HAIL SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH EARLY/MID AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN VA AND NORTHERN/WESTERN NC. A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN ADDED TO PORTIONS OF THE REGION WITH THE 1630Z DAY 1 OUTLOOK. A SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED THIS AFTERNOON...ESPECIALLY ACROSS SOUTHERN VA/NORTHERN NC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL/REMNANT CLUSTER OF TSTMS CONTINUES TO SHIFT EASTWARD ACROSS FAR WESTERN VA/FAR SOUTHERN WV AS OF 1615Z. IT IS PLAUSIBLE THAT THIS PERSISTENT CLUSTER/ASSOCIATED WEAK MCV MAY INFLUENCE SUBSEQUENT DEVELOPMENT INTO PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN VA AS IT SHIFTS EASTWARD...WHILE THE CU FIELD OTHERWISE CONTINUES TO EXPAND/MATURE EARLY THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF VA/NC PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY. GIVEN THE OBSERVED 12Z SOUNDINGS FROM RNK/GSO AND LOWER 60S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS COINCIDENT WITH AMPLE INSOLATION/HEATING...INDICATIONS ARE THAT LINGERING BOUNDARY LAYER INHIBITION WILL QUICKLY ERODE WITH DEVELOPMENT OF MLCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1000-2000 J/KG. THE REGION DOES RESIDE ON THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF MODERATELY STRONG WESTERLIES ALOFT PER 12Z REGIONAL RAOBS AND MORE CONTEMPORARY SATELLITE/WSR-88D DERIVED DATA. THUS...EFFECTIVE SHEAR ON THE ORDER OF 30 KT MAY CONTRIBUTE TO SOME SUSTAINED/VIGOROUS MAINLY MULTICELLULAR STORMS THIS AFTERNOON...WITH DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL POSSIBLE AT LEAST ON AN ISOLATED BASIS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS CAPABLE OF WIND/HAIL ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP/INCREASE THROUGH EARLY/MID AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF MIDDLE/EASTERN TN AND CENTRAL/EASTERN KY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SINCE 1630Z IS INDICATIVE OF AN INCREASING/DEEPENING CU FIELD ACROSS THE TN VALLEY...ESPECIALLY ACROSS PORTIONS OF MIDDLE TO EASTERN TN AND SOUTH-CENTRAL KY/NORTHEAST AL. CONTEMPORARY MODIFICATIONS TO THE 12Z NASHVILLE OBSERVED SOUNDING CONFIRM THAT BOUNDARY LAYER CINH IS VIRTUALLY NIL AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE CLIMBED ABOVE 80F...WITH SPC OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS NOW INDICATIVE OF MLCAPE TO 2000-3000 J/KG. FURTHERMORE...THE REGION IS BEING INFLUENCE BY THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH/MCV ACROSS THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY...AND ITS GRAZING INFLUENCE WILL BE A FACTOR FOR INCREASING TSTM COVERAGE/VIGOR AND SUSTAINABILITY THIS AFTERNOON. AIDED BY RELATIVELY STRONG MID LEVEL WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY FLOW AND RESULTANT EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 30-35 KT...SUSTAINED MULTICELLS/SOME SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ASSOCIATED POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE HAIL/WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS CENTRAL/SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF INDIANA INTO OH THIS AFTERNOON. A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE SHOWN A RECENT INCREASE IN COVERAGE/VIGOR EITHER SIDE OF A WARM FRONT ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL INDIANA. AS CLOUD BREAKS ALLOW FOR FURTHER HEATING ALONG/SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT...THIS SAME UPWARD COVERAGE/INTENSITY TREND SHOULD CONTINUE THROUGH MID-AFTERNOON AHEAD OF AN EASTWARD-MOVING MCV ACROSS NORTHERN/CENTRAL IL. REGIONAL PROFILERS/WSR-88D DERIVED WINDS ARE INDICATIVE OF ENHANCED LOW-MID TROPOSPHERIC FLOW ON THE E/SE PERIPHERY OF THE MCV...WITH LOW LEVEL SRH ESPECIALLY ENHANCED ALONG/NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT WHERE NEAR-SURFACE WINDS ARE BACKED TO EAST-SOUTHEASTERLY. RECENT WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM INDIANAPOLIS REFLECTS 0-1 KM SRH OF 300+ M2/S2. AS SUCH...A TORNADO THREAT MAY INCREASE ACROSS THE REGION ASIDE FROM SEVERE HAIL/WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF A FEW SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING HAIL AND STRONG WINDS. PART OR ALL OF THIS AREA WILL LIKELY NEED A WW BY 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 19Z SURFACE ANALYSIS DEPICTS AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE OVER N-CNTRL SD WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM MBG EWD TO ETH AND THEN SEWD TO AXA AND A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD TO OGA. TEMPERATURES HAVE CLIMBED INTO THE MID TO UPPER 70S SOUTH OF THIS FRONT WITH DEWPOINT VALUES IN THE UPPER 50S TO LOW 60S. AS A RESULT...AN AXIS OF INSTABILITY EXISTS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA WITH THE HIGHEST MLCAPE VALUES /AROUND 1000 J/KG/ IN AND AROUND FSD. CONTINUED HEATING SHOULD ALLOW FOR INCREASED DESTABILIZATION SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT WITH CONVECTIVE INITIATION BECOMING MORE LIKELY. SHEAR PROFILES INDICATE STORM ORGANIZATION IS PROBABLE WITH PRIMARY THREATS OF SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. FARTHER E /ACROSS MN/...BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW INDICATES AN ENHANCED TORNADO THREAT...ESPECIALLY ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING WARM FRONT. HOWEVER...THIS AREA WILL LIKELY REMAIN CAPPED UNTIL AFTER THE WARM FRONT MOVES THROUGH. AS SUCH...VEERING WINDS ALONG AND BEHIND THE FRONT SHOULD KEEP THE TORNADO THREAT ISOLATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MONITORING FOR INCREASING SIGNS OF SURFACE BASED DEEP CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL IL INTO WESTERN INDIANA...WHICH DOES REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON. SHOULD TSTMS OCCUR/INCREASE...AT LEAST AN ISOLATED TORNADO/SEVERE HAIL RISK WOULD EXIST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS REFLECT A THICKENING CU FIELD ACROSS PORTIONS OF EAST-CENTRAL/SOUTH-CENTRAL IL...ESPECIALLY WITH A GENERAL CORRIDOR AROUND THE DECATUR/TAYLORVILLE AREAS AS OF 2030Z. THIS AREA IS IN VICINITY OF A WEST-EAST WARM/STATIONARY FRONT ACROSS THE REGION...AND IS ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF A MID-LEVEL IMPULSE/MCV ACROSS NORTHERN IL. A KEY UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING THE LIKELIHOOD/EXTENT OF DEEP CONVECTION WEST OF TORNADO WATCH 218....GIVEN THAT THE REGION WILL BEGIN TO INCREASINGLY COME UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF SHORTWAVE RIDGING/WEAKENING MASS CONVERGENCE AS THE AFOREMENTIONED MID-LEVEL IMPULSE CONTINUES TO SHIFT EAST-NORTHEASTWARD AWAY FROM THE AREA. THAT SAID...A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE/WEAKLY CAPPED AIRMASS DOES REMAIN ACROSS THE REGION...WITH VERTICAL SHEAR/SRH ACCENTUATED NEAR THE WARM FRONT. INCREASING SIGNS/CONFIDENCE OF DEEP CONVECTIVE INITIATION COULD PROMPT A WATCH ISSUANCE ACROSS IL AND/OR EXPANSION OF WW 218 ACROSS INDIANA. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR A TORNADO/HAIL THREAT THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE FORECAST TO MOVE INTO SERN VA AND ERN NC THROUGH THE EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2145Z...A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WAS LOCATED OVER SRN VA AND NRN NC. AIRMASS AHEAD OF THIS CONVECTION IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S...DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 60S...AND MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 1000 J/KG. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD FAVOR STORM PERSISTENCE AS ACTIVITY MOVES INTO SERN VA AND ERN NC. GIVEN THE PRESENCE EFFECTIVE BULK WIND DIFFERENCE NEAR 30 KT...SVR MULTICELL THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE...POSING A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF SUPERCELLS MAY SPREAD EWD INTO SERN OH AND WRN WV DURING THE EVENING. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS CLUSTERS OF SUPERCELLS OVER SWRN OH/NRN KY...MOVING E AT 30 KT ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 218. DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS OVER SERN OH AND WRN WV IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE ALONG AN E-W SURFACE BAROCLINIC ZONE...WITH MLCAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 500-1500 J/KG. IN ADDITION...ILN VWP SHOWS STRONGLY VEERING DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS. THUS...THREAT FOR A FEW TORNADOES...LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY SPREAD E OF WW 218.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS MAY MOVE ACROSS BIG BEND AREA AND OFF DAVIS MOUNTAINS WITH POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS OR LARGE HAIL. ADDITIONAL TSTMS OVER SERRANIAS DEL BURRO MOUNTAINS OF NRN COAHUILA MAY CROSS RIO GRANDE WITH SPORADIC WIND/HAIL THREAT AS WELL...EITHER FROM LEFT-MOVERS HEADED NWD OR FROM LATER AGGREGATION OF FORWARD-PROPAGATING/COLD-POOL DRIVEN CONVECTION MOVING EWD TOWARD DRT AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 22Z SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED DRYLINE FROM SWRN CORNER OF OK SWWD BETWEEN SNK-BPG...THEN SSWWD JUST W OF 6R6 AND INTO NWRN SLOPES OF MEX MOUNTAINS E OF BIG BEND. VIS IMAGERY SHOWED TCU AND YOUNG CBS W OF DRYLINE...OVER HIGHER TERRAIN FROM BIG BEND NATIONAL PARK NWD PAST MRF...ALL MOVING NEWD. CONVECTION BEHIND DRYLINE WILL MOVE OVER HOT...DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPS 90S F AND 45-60 DEG F DEW POINT DEPRESSIONS...BEFORE DRYLINE BACKS INTO REGION. EVEN IN DRY AIR...MLCAPE 500-1200 J/KG IS EVIDENT FROM MODIFIED RR AND ETA-KF SOUNDINGS...ATOP DCAPE 1000-2000 J/KG. EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES 30-40 KT MAY AID STORM ORGANIZATION IN SUPPORT OF PRIMARY SVR GUST THREAT...WITH HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE. AIR MASS E OF DRYLINE...OVER LOWER ELEVATIONS...IS CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS MID-UPPER 60S F AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH ELEVATED MIXED LAYER. RESULT IS EXTREME BUOYANCY FOR ANY TSTMS THAT CAN MOVE OFF HIGHER TERRAIN INTO VALLEY...WITH PEAK MLCAPE APCHG 5000 J/KG. TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ALSO ARE POSSIBLE...BUT MAINLY OVER MEX...BEFORE STORM MODES POTENTIALLY GET MESSIER AROUND RIO GRANDE. ANY LEFT-MOVERS OR RELATIVELY DISCRETE RIGHT MOVING SUPERCELLS THAT DO REACH TX CAN PRODUCE DAMAGING HAIL AND GUSTS...BUT THREAT IS VERY CONDITIONAL. SOME POTENTIAL ALSO EXISTS FOR UPSCALE COLD-POOL GROWTH WITH MEX CONVECTION THAT COULD SEND FORWARD-PROPAGATING TSTM CLUSTER EWD ACROSS RIO GRANDE WITH POTENTIAL FOR STG-SVR GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SHORT-TERM TORNADO THREAT MAY BE MAXIMIZED OVER W-CNTRL IND. OTHERWISE...SVR WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW 218.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS AT 22Z SHOWS AN AREA OF WEAK LOW PRESSURE SITUATED OVER E-CNTRL IL...WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING SEWD INTO SERN IND...AND THEN EWD ACROSS SRN OH. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE INDICATES AXIS OF HIGHEST SURFACE THETA-E VALUES EXTEND NWD OUT OF SRN IL INTO W-CNTRL IND. IN ADDITION...0-1 KM SRH IS MAXIMIZED ALONG AND TO THE COOL SIDE OF THE WARM FRONT OVER W-CNTRL INTO CNTRL IND. THUS...SUPERCELL MOVING E-SEWD ALONG WARM FRONT OVER W-CNTRL IND SHOULD POSE THE GREATEST THREAT FOR TORNADOES IN THE SHORT-TERM. OTHER CLUSTERS OF STORMS FORMING SEWD ALONG THE FRONT IN IND WILL POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. ..GARNER.. 05/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ANOTHER WW...223...IS BEING ISSUED E OF WW 220 ACROSS ADJACENT PORTIONS ERN MN AND WRN WI. SVR THREAT CONTINUES IN WW 220 WITH BAND OF TSTMS FROM CENTRAL MN SWWD ACROSS SERN SD. WW MAY BE CLEARED BEHIND SFC LOW AND COLD FRONT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 22Z SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS TRIPLE-POINT LOW BETWEEN GHW-FFM...WARM FRONT SEWD FROM THERE MKT/OTM AREAS. WARM FRONT WILL LIFT NEWD ACROSS SERN MN AROUND 10-15 KT. THIS IS SLOWER THAN PACE OF INDIVIDUAL TSTMS MOVING ACROSS FRONT...BUT MAXIMIZING AMOUNT OF TIME CELLS SPEND IN BAROCLINIC ZONE FOR SUCH STRONGLY ORTHOGONAL CONVECTIVE TRANSLATION COMPONENT. TORNADO THREAT WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY ENHANCED IN WARM FRONTAL ZONE...WHERE 1. TRANSITION FROM SFC-BASED TO ELEVATED EFFECTIVE-INFLOW PARCELS IS GRADUAL WITH SW-NE EXTENT... 2. LOW-LEVEL STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW...VERTICAL SHEAR AND HODOGRAPH SIZE ALL WILL REMAIN MAXIMIZED. MEANWHILE LOW SHOULD MOVE ENEWD TO NEWD ACROSS NRN MN..WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT MOVES SEWD OVER SWRN MN AND SERN SD. COLD FRONT IS CLOSE TO TSTMS EVIDENT AT 23Z FROM NW BKX TO MHE...AND SHOULD CATCH UP TO PRIMARY CONVECTIVE BAND OVER SERN SD DURING NEXT 2-3 HOURS. MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST MLCAPE INCREASES FROM AROUND 500 J/KG IN WARM-FRONTAL ZONE TO AROUND 200 J/KG OVER SERN SD...WITH 35-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES. BKN AND SEGMENTED TO QUASI-LINEAR STRUCTURES SHOULD PREDOMINATE NEAR COLD FRONT GIVEN NEARLY PARALLEL ALIGNMENT OF MEAN WIND AND DEEP-SHEAR VECTORS. INCREASE IN LLJ ACROSS IA THROUGH LATE EVENING WILL SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH OF CONVECTION INTO BETTER-ORGANIZED MCS...AND MORE OF IA IN SVR THREAT ALSO. ..EDWARDS.. 05/01/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE THROUGH AROUND 03Z FOR OCNL SVR HAIL WITH BKN/SW-NE BAND OF MULTICELLULAR TSTMS MOVING EWD OVER DISCUSSION AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 23Z SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED LOW OVER EXTREME NERN ND...WITH WAVY/OCCLUDED FRONT SSEWD OVER FAR AREA THEN SEWD TO TRIPLE-POINT LOW IN W-CENTRAL MN. THIS LOW SHOULD MOVE EWD ACROSS NW ANGLE AREA OF MN WITH OCCLUDED FRONT DOING LIKEWISE OVER NWRN/N-CENTRAL MN. CORRIDOR OF SFC SELYS AND RELATED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE HAS BECOME JUXTAPOSED WITH LATE-AFTERNOON SFC HEATING INVOF FRONT...LEADING TO WEAKLY CAPPED PLUME OF 500-1000 MLCAPE ASTRIDE RED RIVER VALLEY. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WEAKENS WITH NWWD EXTENT...I.E. EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES NEAR 50 KT OVER NERN PORTIONS WW 220 BUT AROUND 30 KT OVER NERN SD AND EXTREME NWRN MN. UPPER FLOW LIKELY WILL BACK WITH TIME AHEAD OF MID-UPPER LEVEL PERTURBATION MOVING ENEWD OUT OF WY AND WRN SD...REDUCING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SOMEWHAT. ALSO...COMBINATION OF DIABATIC SFC COOLING...AND SPREAD OF OUTFLOW FROM EXISTING CONVECTION...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO STABILIZATION...ESPECIALLY AFTER ABOUT 01Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW MAY BE CLEARED BEHIND PRIMARY BAND OF CONVECTION AND RELATED SFC COLD FRONT OVER NRN NEB AND SERN SD. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE MAY BE REQUIRED DURING NEXT COUPLE HOURS OVER PORTIONS OF CORRIDOR FROM S-CENTRAL NEB TO NWRN IA. DAMAGING GUSTS AND SVR HAIL REMAIN PRIMARY CONCERNS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 00Z...MAIN TSTM BAND WAS LOCATED FROM FSD AREA SWWD OVER EXTREME ERN BOYD COUNTY NEB...EXTRAPOLATING SWD TO ISOLATED SVR TSTMS OVER ROCK COUNTY NEB. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT GENERALLY EWD ACROSS NERN NEB/SERN SD/NWRN IA REGION. SFC STREAMLINE ANALYSIS REVEALED QUASISTATIONARY AND PREFRONTAL CONFLUENCE LINE FROM NEAR YKN SSWWD BETWEEN HSI-EAR...THEN INTERSECTING DRYLINE BULGE AND WEAK MESOLOW INVOF HLC. ISOLATED TSTM HAS DEVELOPED WHERE THIS CONFLUENCE LINE JUXTAPOSES WITH SFC THERMAL AXIS...ACCORDINGLY MAXIMIZING BOUNDARY-LAYER LIFT. 35-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR VECTORS ALIGNED NEARLY PARALLEL WITH ZONES OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL FORCING SUPPORT EVENTUAL QUASI-LINEAR ORGANIZATION...ALTHOUGH EML-RELATED CINH SHOULD FOSTER SOME DISCRETE CELLS BEFORE SUCH UPSCALE DEVELOPMENT/GROWTH. MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST MLCAPE AROUND 1500-2000 J/KG...WHICH SHOULD CHANGE LITTLE THROUGH ABOUT 02Z BEFORE SLOW NOCTURNAL DECREASE. LLJ IS EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN CONTERMINOUSLY OVER THIS REGION...HOWEVER...OFFERING ENHANCED STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW AND MOISTURE TRANSPORT FOR TSTMS EITHER BACKBUILDING FROM MN/SD MCS OR DEVELOPING ANEW ACROSS NEB. ..EDWARDS.. 05/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS LOCATED FROM CNTRL IND INTO SRN OH ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY ELEVATED AND POSE A MARGINAL TORNADO THREAT. STORMS ENTERING WRN WV WILL ENCOUNTER AN AIRMASS SLIGHTLY MORE FAVORABLE FOR SURFACE BASED THUNDERSTORMS. ACTIVITY MAY SPREAD EWD INTO CNTRL WV...WHICH COULD REQUIRE SPATIAL EXPANSION OF WW 222 BY LOCAL WFO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0130Z...WARM FRONT EXTENDED SEWD FROM W-CNTRL IND INTO FAR NRN KY...AND THEN CURVED BACK TO THE NE INTO FAR WRN WV. SURFACE AIRMASS N OF THE WARM FRONT HAS BEEN WORKED OVER EXTENSIVELY BY MULTIPLE ROUNDS OF THUNDERSTORMS...YIELDING TEMPERATURES THAT ARE NOW IN THE 60S. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE INDICATES MUCAPE VALUES RANGE FROM 500-1000 J/KG N OF THE FRONT...AND MAY SUPPORT A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUST/BRIEF TORNADO...GIVEN EFFECTIVE BULK WIND DIFFERENCE VALUES FROM 40-50 KT. FARTHER E OVER WV...SURFACE TEMPERATURES REMAIN NEAR 70 WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 60S. THIS IS ALLOWING A CORRIDOR OF HIGHER THETA-E AND SURFACE BASED INSTABILITY TO PERSIST. IN ADDITION...RLX VWP SHOWS SHEAR PROFILES QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS...WITH 0-1 KM SRH NEAR 200 M2 S-2 AND 0-6 KM BULK WIND DIFFERENCE IN EXCESS OF 40 KT. GIVEN THIS ENVIRONMENT...SVR THREAT COULD SPREAD EWD FROM WRN INTO CNTRL WV DURING THE NEXT HR OR TWO. ..GARNER.. 05/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW MAY BE CLEARED BEHIND MAIN CONVECTIVE BAND. PRIMARY SVR THREAT IS FROM DAMAGING GUSTS...WITH ISOLATED HAIL ALSO EXPECTED. BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO STILL MAY OCCUR FROM EITHER BOOKEND/BOW VORTICES OR MISOCIRCULATIONS ALONG LEADING EDGE OF QLCS. OVERALL SVR POTENTIAL SHOULD CONTINUE TO LESSEN WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS WW AREA. HOWEVER...SMALL PORTION OF SERN MN AND NERN IA SE OF WW MAY EXPERIENCE THREAT FOR SVR GUSTS BEFORE MCS NOW ALONG MN/IA BORDER WEAKENS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER WARM FRONT HAS BECOME QUASISTATIONARY ACROSS THIS REGION...AND WAS ANALYZED AT 3Z FROM W-CENTRAL IL NEAR OTM...MCW AND S-CENTRAL MN SW OF TWIN CITIES. NARROW CORRIDOR OF N-CENTRAL/NERN IA AND IMMEDIATE MN BORDER REGION W OF FRONT IS CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE 500-1000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR 40-50 KT...BASED ON MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS. MCS SHOULD CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD AROUND 30 KT...WHICH VIA EXTRAPOLATION WOULD MOVE IT EWD OUT OF WW AROUND 5Z. LOCAL ACCELERATIONS OF COLD POOL CAUSED BY BOWING MAY HASTEN THAT PROCESS SLIGHTLY. AS THIS OCCURS...WARM SECTOR EFFECTIVELY WILL SHRINK FROM S-N...AS MN PORTION OF COMPLEX GOES ATOP FRONTAL SFC THEN PROCEEDS EWD OVER PROGRESSIVELY DEEPER AND MORE STABLE LAYER OF LOW THETAE. SVR THREAT THEREFORE WILL BE DISPLACED SWD INTO WW 224 WITH TIME. ..EDWARDS.. 05/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: EXPECT INITIALLY SEPARATE AREAS OF CONVECTION OVER NWRN IA AND ERN NEB TO CONSOLIDATE AND SHIFT EWD ACROSS WW AREA. AS THIS OCCURS...INITIAL HAIL THREAT WITH ERN NEB CONVECTION SHOULD TRANSITION MORE TOWARD DAMAGING GUSTS...WITH LARGE HAIL STILL POSSIBLE...WHILE DAMAGING WIND REMAINS PRIMARY CONCERN OVER NWRN IA. NRN PORTION OF IA MCS SHOULD WEAKEN AFTER CROSSING FRONTAL ZONE OUTLINED BELOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 4Z SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED QUASISTATIONARY FRONT FROM W-CENTRAL IL NWWD ACROSS OTM AND MCW AREAS THEN NWD INTO EXTREME SRN MN...WHERE IT WILL CONTINUE TO BE OVERTAKEN BY MCS. BOUNDARY LAYER E OF THIS FRONT WILL REMAIN CHARACTERIZED BY PROGRESSIVELY DEEPER AND LOWER-THETAE AIR...AND RELATED STRENGTHENING OF MLCINH WITH EWD EXTENT. SOME PARTS OF TSTM COMPLEX MAY BE MAINTAINED ATOP ERN IA AIR MASS BY INCREASING ELEVATED BUOYANCY. THIS WILL BE RELATED TO WAA AND MOISTURE TRANSPORT FOSTERED BY 50-60 KT SWLY LLJ...WHICH WILL HAVE PASSED THROUGH 850-MB MOISTURE MAX ANALYZED AT 00Z NEAR TOP. HOWEVER...SVR GUST POTENTIAL WILL BE REDUCED EWD FROM FRONT BY STABLE LAYER. FARTHER SW ACROSS WRN/CENTRAL IA...MLCINH WILL BE WEAKER AND SLOW TO BUILD...GIVEN RELATIVELY HIGH BOUNDARY-LAYER THETAE AND PROSPECT OF STG LIFT FROM FORCED ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH GROWING CONVECTIVE COMPLEX. FCST SOUNDINGS AND MODIFIED RAOBS SUGGEST MLCAPE INCREASES FROM AROUND 500 J/KG...IN NARROWING WARM SECTOR NEAR MN BORDER...TO ABOVE 2500 J/KG OVER SERN NEB. SUBTLE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT FROM APCHG CENTRAL/ERN NEB SHORTWAVE TROUGH SHOULD HELP TO MAINTAIN STEEP LAPSE RATES AND BUOYANCY OVER PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS...IN CONJUNCTION WITH FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES IN 40-50 KT RANGE WILL CONTINUE...AND MAY INTENSIFY SLIGHTLY AS GRADIENT WINDS ALOFT RESPOND TO APCHG PERTURBATION. AS SUCH...SVR THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE ACROSS REMAINDER WW AREA IN SERN NEB/IA...AND MAY EXTEND TO PORTIONS OF CENTRAL/SRN IA NEAR AND W OF FRONT BUT NOT YET IN ANY WW. ..EDWARDS.. 05/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND AN ISOLATED/BRIEF TORNADO CONTINUES ACROSS CENTRAL IA -- PARTICULARLY INVOF THE DES MOINES AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A COMPLEX BOWING SEGMENT WITHIN THE BROADER LINE MOVING INTO DALLAS AND STORY COUNTY ATTM...WITH THE STRONGEST SURGE LIKELY TO REMAIN JUST N OF DSM. ALONG THIS ENHANCED PORTION OF THE LINE...WINDS IN EXCESS OF 55 KT ARE BEING OBSERVED ROUGHLY 1500 AGL PER LATEST VWP DATA...AND SMALL CIRCULATION SPIN-UPS ALONG THE GUST FRONT ARE ALSO EVIDENT. WHILE THE ACCELERATION IN THIS PORTION OF THE LINE REPRESENTS A LOCAL RAMP-UP IN SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL...IT APPEARS THAT THIS THREAT SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY SHORT-LIVED...AS THE BOUNDARY-LAYER AIRMASS ACROSS ERN IA -- ON THE ERN SIDE OF THE NW-SE FRONT -- REMAINS STABLE. THUS -- WHILE STORMS CONTINUE THROUGH THE NARROW INSTABILITY AXIS...SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE...BUT EXPECT AN OVERALL DECREASE WITH TIMES AS UPDRAFTS CROSS THE SURFACE FRONT AND BEGIN TO BECOME ELEVATED. ..GOSS.. 05/02/2012
